name: Aion 1.0 Instruct 2.3B

lineage.family: Aion (successor of the Windows OS small language model Phi Silica)
lineage.how_derived: trained on an extension of the Phi Silica data (filtered public documents plus synthetic data for math, coding, reasoning, world knowledge); about 6 % multilingual; the card describes no base checkpoint

purpose: The foundational small language model of the Windows ecosystem for on-device text and OS scenarios: summarization, rewriting, chat, document comprehension, question answering. A further optimized version with a content-moderation model is planned as the Windows OS SLM by end of January 2027; this Hugging Face release is an introduction and a request for feedback.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read (head): standard MIT text, Microsoft Corporation.

architecture.kind: dense hybrid sliding-window + full attention transformer (custom code)
architecture.gguf_arch: unknown (community GGUF repos exist; arch name not checked)
architecture.attention: GQA 24 Q / 8 KV heads, head dim 128; 21 sliding-window layers (window 2048) and 7 full-attention layers; RoPE theta 32000 with YaRN factor 16 on full layers
architecture.why_this_design: The card gives no architecture reasons beyond the on-device goal and 32K context.

variants.notes: the card says quantized versions follow; ONNX WebGPU repo exists (microsoft/Aion-1.0-Instruct-2.3B-ONNX-WebGPU)
sizes not recorded; also Xylolabs GGUF and an MLX 8-bit repo

engine_support.notes: Custom modeling code; community GGUF repos exist but llama.cpp architecture support was not verified.

weaknesses: Not trained for world knowledge (card); GPQA 28, MMLU-Pro 33
No coding or agent benchmarks on the card
Microsoft states safety metrics XPIA, DIC and ECI need improvement
soft.behavior: Short-form text tasks; the card advises pairing with a moderation model.
soft.maturity: Released one day before the check date; 788 downloads, no discussions; the production Windows version follows by January 2027.

tona_fit.reason: Text-assistant model without coding or agent focus and weak knowledge scores; below the purpose of Tona. Revisit when the optimized Windows OS version appears.

open_questions: llama.cpp architecture support for the community GGUF files
